sloka: अद्य वैवस्वतो राजा भूयो बहुमतो मम।येनाद्य त्वं महाबाहो संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा ।। ६.९३.८ ।।
transliteration: adya vaivasvato rājā bhūyo bahumato mama।yenādya tvaṁ mahābāho saṁyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā ।। 6.93.8 ।।

translations.english: 'O mighty armed! Today by virtue of time you have joined Yama and become esteemed King'.
